title: B. Internet HTTPS entry, regional WAF, private origins
subtitle: Remote developers need no corporate tunnel for this ingress. Entra, entitlement and budgets remain at APIM. This is the live-tested Application Gateway path, not evidence for a Front Door deployment.

groups.title: Internet and identity boundaries - only the selected WAF listener is public
Customer Azure subscription - TLS across the regional edge and private inference origins
Private resource dependencies - no developer API keys or certificate private keys
Independent monitoring and application choices - public ingress is not public backend access

nodes.title: Remote developer
lines: Claude Code, VS Code extension or Desktop
HTTPS/443, developer Entra bearer token and verified listener certificate.
Public client DNS chooses the WAF address. Direct APIM callers must migrate to this hostname.

nodes.title: Microsoft Entra ID
lines: Public HTTPS/443 sign-in and refresh; delegated OAuth.
Existing MFA/Conditional Access remains in force.
Identity is validated by APIM, not by a source-IP address, WAF rule or client-supplied header.

nodes.title: Discovered public IP and DNS
lines: Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses
Standard static address, selected region and approved public listener name.
HTTPS/443 terminates at WAF then re-encrypts. DDoS protection is a separately priced administrator decision.

nodes.title: Public WAF v2 listener
lines: [[edge]]
[[waf]]
Dedicated edge subnet, HTTPS/443.
Body inspection/enforcement, scoped code-field exclusions and scrubbed match logs.
HTTP/2 frontend; SSE response buffering off. HTTPS origin timeout 600 seconds.

nodes.title: Preferred origin: Standard v2
lines: Microsoft.ApiManagement/service
Inbound private endpoint; public access disabled.
HTTPS/443, unchanged developer token. Trusted edge-source restriction precedes JWT and budgets.
Outbound integration is a separate Microsoft.Web/serverFarms subnet.
APIM managed identity authenticates HTTPS/443 calls to private Foundry.

nodes.title: Private Foundry inference
lines: Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts
Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints, account subresource.
Public network access disabled after the private backend is verified.
Managed identity and scoped data-plane role; no developer model key.
Private Foundry does not require an internet WAF client to join the VNet.

nodes.title: Separate network functions
lines: Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks
[[nsg]]
Dedicated edge subnet; separate APIM integration and non-delegated endpoint subnets.
No inbound integration-subnet NSG is claimed to govern the APIM gateway listener.
Discover existing routes and policy attachments; never replace a shared VNet.

nodes.title: Private certificate retrieval
lines: Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults
[[certificate-identity]]
Edge certificate identity: HTTPS/443, Secrets User at the selected vault.
Versionless reference supports renewal. Use the approved issuer; never disable client TLS checks.

nodes.title: Private origin resolution
lines: Microsoft.Network/privateDnsZones and virtualNetworkLinks
APIM, Foundry and vault endpoint zone groups point to the discovered zones.
DNS UDP/TCP 53 through Azure DNS or the approved resolver.
Client public DNS still resolves the WAF public IP. Zones are not resources inside an endpoint subnet.

nodes.title: Evidence, not payload capture
lines: Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces and Microsoft.Insights/components
Azure-managed access/firewall diagnostics; HTTPS/443 for authorized log queries.
Use the gateway-owned request ID to join trusted client IP with the ledger.
Reference history has masked IPs and incomplete gateway categories. Review uncertainty before reducing access.

nodes.title: Optional estate is separate
lines: Resolver Function -> Cosmos DB: HTTPS/443, separate reader MI and private endpoints.
Turnstile App Service -> PostgreSQL: TLS/5432; own integration subnet and data authorization.
Container Apps jobs -> ARM/logs: HTTPS/443, scoped workload MI.
An edge profile does not migrate these services or grant Graph application consent.

nodes.title: Priced alternatives, not substitutions
lines: Front Door Premium: Microsoft.Cdn/profiles, WAF and approved managed Private Link origin.
Public ingress only; test its SSE, timeout and size limits separately. Reference-only in P54.
Basic v2 fallback uses a public APIM origin with edge source-IP restriction, and a public Foundry path.
Basic v2 has no inbound PE or outbound VNet integration.

notice: Live: native Claude Code, Prevention/Detection replay, long SSE/nonstream responses, body/header probes, forged-IP rejection and private-origin bypass refusal. Front Door, DDoS, corporate egress restriction and a complete optional-estate migration were not tested.
